name: Vital Earth
text: Life-infused soil from the Plane of Earth, vital earth is glittering dust you inhale that causes you to not need air or water for 24 hours. Also, for this time, your wounds close easily, like molding clay, meaning someone attempting to Administer First Aid or Treat Wounds on you doesn't need a healer's toolkit and gains a +1 item bonus to the Medicine check.
